title: Do Evaluation Metrics Detect Errors in Classical Chinese to English Translations?
abstract: arXiv:2608.08283v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Although large language models can translate some historical languages surprisingly well, their usefulness in digital humanities workflows is limited by the lack of reliable evaluation. We investigate whether existing automatic evaluation metrics developed for modern languages are reliable in this setting, using translation from Classical Chinese to English as a test case. We introduce a diagnostic framework based on minimal pairs capturing error types salient in scholarly use, probing both reference-based and reference-free metrics for error sensitivity and tolerance to valid variation. We find that all metrics exhibit blind spots, however MetricX24 performs best overall. Our findings highlight the need for more robust and interpretable metrics for historically and culturally distinct translation settings.

translated_title: 评估指标能否检测古文汉语到英语翻译中的错误？
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.08283v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：尽管大型语言模型在某些历史语言的翻译上表现出色，但由于缺乏可靠的评估方法，它们在数字人文学科工作流程中的实用性受到限制。我们以古文汉语到英语的翻译为测试案例，调查了为现代语言开发的现有自动评估指标在此场景下是否可靠。我们引入了一个基于最小对（minimal pairs）的诊断框架，捕捉学术使用中突出的错误类型，并同时探测基于参考和无参考的指标在错误敏感性和对有效变异的容忍度方面的表现。我们发现所有指标都存在盲点，但MetricX24整体表现最佳。我们的发现强调了在历史和文化独特翻译场景中，需要更稳健且可解释的评估指标。
tldr: 本文通过最小对诊断框架评估了自动翻译指标在古文汉语到英语翻译中的可靠性，发现所有指标均有盲点，但MetricX24表现最优，凸显了开发更稳健指标的必要性。
en_tdlr: This paper evaluates automatic metrics for Classical Chinese-to-English translation using a minimal-pair diagnostic framework, finding all metrics have blind spots with MetricX24 performing best, highlighting the need for more robust metrics.
